title: Wake after sedation — 60-second ICU audio scene
scene: Rohan is waking after sedation. He hears a ventilator alarm and briefly believes transport is still underway. The clinician orients him to ICU. The library called help; the ambulance performed CPR; the resuscitation bay restored sustained circulation; this ward begins afterward.

fullTranscript.speaker: SFX
fullTranscript.text: [Low ICU ambience. Soft controlled ventilator breaths.]

fullTranscript.speaker: AD
fullTranscript.text: Daylight paediatric ICU. Rohan’s eyes open. Ventilator circuit and cheek switch within reach.

fullTranscript.speaker: SFX
fullTranscript.text: [One brief ventilator alarm — high pressure. Stops.]

fullTranscript.speaker: Rohan AAC
fullTranscript.text: THE AMBULANCE KEPT THE CODE GOING.

fullTranscript.speaker: Clinician
fullTranscript.text: Rohan. You are in ICU. Not the ambulance.

fullTranscript.speaker: Clinician
fullTranscript.text: Your airway is open. The ventilator is delivering breaths.

fullTranscript.speaker: AD
fullTranscript.text: Clinician sits at eye level. Restores cheek-switch yes and no.

fullTranscript.speaker: Clinician
fullTranscript.text: Yes is one press. No is two. Are you in pain right now?

fullTranscript.speaker: Clinician
fullTranscript.text: Thank you. We will treat the pain. One more question—

fullTranscript.speaker: Clinician
fullTranscript.text: Stopping questions. I am here. Communication stays on.

fullTranscript.speaker: AD
fullTranscript.text: Alarm quiet. Access remains. Delirium fragments may continue.
